name: color-figures
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,base64
p=Path.cwd()
for page in [10,11,12]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1400','-png','-singlefile',str(p/'sources/color.pdf')],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 z=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/color-page{page}.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0
 print(page,len(r.stdout))
